Subject: internal: audit results + proposed remediation for Everwell (Invoice RW-202610)

Marissa / Markus — summary of our quick audit:
- Root cause: duplicate ingestion transactions from our third-party S3 connector that retried messages on intermittent timeouts. Dedup logic failed for 03:17–03:54 UTC on 2026-10-18.
- Volume: ~60,400 duplicated input tokens across four jobs (see attached internal logs, Drive link above).
- Financial impact: $9,200.40 in billable tokens attributable to duplication.

Proposed remediation (clean & customer-friendly):
1) Issue a credit note for $9,200.40 referencing Invoice #RW-202610.
2) In addition, offer a one-time goodwill concession of $800.00 (to acknowledge the operational disruption and AP admin burden). Total concession = $10,000.40.
3) VAT/tax handling: invoice shows two charge lines that map to Everwell GmbH (EU). We recommend issuing the credit note with a line-item split: net amount (EUR/USD conversion logged), VAT component for EU line so Everwell GmbH can reclaim. For the US entity we will issue a standard credit note (no VAT).
4) Docs: prepare a DocuSign settlement acknowledgement for AP to sign; include accounting entries and a CSV detailed token reconciliation.

Questions for you: are we comfortable offering the full duplication credit + the $800 goodwill (total $10k)? That exceeds the typical provisional $5k but given the clear duplication and the quick audit, I think it's reasonable to expedite reconciliation and preserve the account.

If ok, I'll draft the credit note, the DocuSign packet, and route to AP. Happy to compress timelines and issue credit within 2 business days of sign-off.

— Monica

- Redwood will issue a credit note for $9,200.40 referencing Invoice #RW-202610 and will add a one-time goodwill payment of $800.00 (total value applied: $10,000.40).

   - Reissue a corrected statement reflecting the net/VAT split for your ledgers.

Please reply with acceptance or any questions. We can also schedule a short 15-minute call if you want to walk through the token reconciliation line-by-line.
